CvProfile.title: CV Profile Version
CvProfile.description: A tailored version of a candidate's academic curriculum vitae for a specific research field or university application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CV profile version.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Descriptive name for this CV version.

text.description: Complete raw text content of the tailored CV.

targetInstitutions.description: Target universities or labs for this profile.

notes.description: Candidate's personal notes on this version.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the primary active CV.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

/users/{userId}/cv_profiles/{profileId}.description: Collection of tailored CV profile versions owned by a user.
